speaker: valdris
line: Another descent. The anvil remembers every one.

speaker: smithshade
line: Back again, and in fewer pieces than I feared.

speaker: valdris
line: Stand behind me. It is the safest place left in the world. The bar is low.

speaker: valdris
line: Cracks in the armor. The anvil has seen worse. On me, mostly.

speaker: valdris
line: Down. Not done. Lift with your legs. I am heavy.

speaker: valdris
line: Up. The wall needs every stone.

speaker: valdris
line: Tell the Smithshade... hit harder this time.

speaker: valdris
line: The mountain stands. Someone find me a chair that will hold.

speaker: valdris
line: Anvil's hot! Forge. I'll hold the door.

speaker: valdris
line: Colossus Cannon ready! Mountainfall on your word.

speaker: valdris
line: Danger. Get behind me.

speaker: valdris
line: Parts here. Take them. I'll carry the rest of you.

speaker: valdris
line: Another of me. The Unmade should have stayed home.

speaker: valdris
line: More of me. Good. A wall is better with more wall.

speaker: valdris
line: They keep walking into the wall. I keep being the wall.

speaker: valdris
line: Big. Good. Big things fall loud.

speaker: valdris
line: It fell. Mountains always do, in the end. I would know.

speaker: valdris
line: Two into one. Stronger for it. Like me, after every death.

speaker: valdris
line: Gold. The Smithshade will pretend he isn't proud.

speaker: valdris
line: Overdrive! Forward, all of you. The wall is advancing.

speaker: valdris
line: Home. The anvil is warmer than the welcome. Both are enough.

speaker: selene
line: Try to keep up. And try not to stand where I'm aiming.

speaker: selene
line: Silence. My second favorite sound, after thunder.

speaker: selene
line: I'm fine. This is a strategic amount of bleeding.

speaker: selene
line: This is humiliating. Revive me before anyone important notices.

speaker: selene
line: Up you get. You owe me a storm.

speaker: selene
line: No. Again. The anvil knows exactly what I deserve.

speaker: selene
line: Your element, my lightning. You're welcome.

speaker: selene
line: Overdrive! Let the heavens take notes.

speaker: selene
line: Another screen deleted. Do try to look impressed.

speaker: selene
line: You're the finale? I've struck taller steeples.

speaker: selene
line: And that is the end of your phase. And your everything.

speaker: selene
line: Tell them the sky took me. Not... whatever that was.

speaker: selene
line: Obviously. Write it down: Selene did most of it.

speaker: selene
line: Anvil's hot! Guard me while I make this weapon worthy of me.

speaker: selene
line: Heaven's Verdict is ready. Stand in my storm and you'll hit harder.

speaker: selene
line: Danger there! Keep it off me. I break.

speaker: selene
line: Loot! Bring it here. I'll make it famous.

speaker: selene
line: Another Selene? Finally, someone who can keep up.

speaker: selene
line: Two storms in one sky. One of us is the lesser storm. It isn't me.

speaker: kael
line: Full mag. One life. Somebody else's.

speaker: kael
line: Quiet. Keep moving.

speaker: kael
line: Bleeding. Been worse. Been dead.

speaker: kael
line: Down. Save a bullet for whatever did it.

speaker: kael
line: On your feet. Dying's my trick.

speaker: kael
line: Again. Luck owes me.

speaker: kael
line: Gold. Suits me.

speaker: kael
line: Nice. Do that again.

speaker: kael
line: Didn't miss. Not starting now.

speaker: kael
line: Big ones drop the same. Louder.

speaker: kael
line: Figures. Reload me.

speaker: kael
line: Walked out. Nobody walks out. Huh.

speaker: kael
line: Back. Nobody missed me. Good.

speaker: kael
line: Anvil's hot. Make it quick.

speaker: kael
line: Bullet Ballet's loaded. Say when.

speaker: kael
line: Danger. There.

speaker: kael
line: Parts. Grab 'em.

speaker: kael
line: Another me. One of us is the ghost. Don't ask which.

speaker: kael
line: More ghosts. Crowded afterlife.

speaker: thessaly
line: Turrets primed, hexes wound, will unwritten. Shall we?

speaker: thessaly
line: Room's clear. Recalibrating the curse. And my nerves.

speaker: thessaly
line: Structural integrity: questionable. Mine, specifically.

speaker: thessaly
line: Minor design flaw. I'm the flaw. Tether me.

speaker: thessaly
line: Patched. Don't make me void your warranty.

speaker: thessaly
line: Two parts, one purpose. If it hums, that's normal. If it sings, run.

speaker: thessaly
line: Godforged. I'd kill for the schematics. I'd settle for surviving it.

speaker: thessaly
line: A new recipe! Someone write it down before it writes us down.

speaker: thessaly
line: Curse plus element. Beautiful arithmetic. Terrible for them.

speaker: thessaly
line: The curse is compounding. I do love a good interest rate.

speaker: thessaly
line: Big, loud and badly engineered. Let's file a complaint.

speaker: thessaly
line: Well. That's one way to test the failsafe.

speaker: thessaly
line: Everything I built worked. Mark the date. It won't happen twice.

speaker: thessaly
line: Anvil's hot! Hands off my wiring and cover me.

speaker: thessaly
line: Sabbath of Sparks is ready. Turrets, Echoes: everyone gets a turn.

speaker: thessaly
line: Danger! Reads as angry. Very angry.

speaker: thessaly
line: Salvage here. I can make that someone else's problem.

speaker: thessaly
line: Another me. At last, a colleague who reads the manual.

speaker: thessaly
line: More of me, one budget. We'll be arguing about wiring by the second room.

speaker: brax
line: Oh, I love this part! The part where we punch everything!

speaker: brax
line: Aw, all gone already? I was just warming up!

speaker: brax
line: Ha! Getting a bit crispy! Still punching!

speaker: brax
line: I'm fine! I'm lying down on purpose! ...Little help?

speaker: brax
line: Up you go, friend! Now let's hit something together!

speaker: brax
line: Squish 'em together! Bigger is better!

speaker: brax
line: OVERDRIVE! Everybody punch! Even the gun people!

speaker: brax
line: Is anyone counting? I lost count! Keep 'em coming!

speaker: brax
line: You're HUGE! I'm gonna punch you so much!

speaker: brax
line: Down goes the big one! High fives all around!

speaker: brax
line: Worth it! Tell the Smithshade I want the same fists back!

speaker: brax
line: We won! Can we go again? I want to go again!

speaker: brax
line: Home! Did anyone see that last punch? I was dead, so I missed it!

speaker: brax
line: Anvil's hot! Forge something that punches!

speaker: brax
line: Meltdown's ready! Point me at the biggest one!

speaker: brax
line: Big scary one over there! I'll go say hello!

speaker: brax
line: Ooh, shiny! Loot over here!

speaker: brax
line: Another me?! Best! Day! Ever!

speaker: brax
line: More Braxes! We should start a band. The band is punching.

speaker: ossian
line: The hunt begins. May our quarry be worthy of the ending.

speaker: ossian
line: The field is still. Do not trust it.

speaker: ossian
line: The hunter bleeds. The hunt does not stop.

speaker: ossian
line: I am the quarry now. Come quickly.

speaker: ossian
line: Rise. The hunt is not finished with you.

speaker: ossian
line: No. Show me another. Patience is also a weapon.

speaker: ossian
line: A new pattern. The hunt-god kept such things in his memory. Now I keep them.

speaker: ossian
line: Struck together, as a pack should. Again.

speaker: ossian
line: One breath. One shot. Again. Again.

speaker: ossian
line: At last. Quarry worthy of the hunt-god's name.

speaker: ossian
line: Rest, great one. You were hunted well.

speaker: ossian
line: A good death is a patient one. This was not patient.

speaker: ossian
line: The hunt is ended. I will name each of them in my prayers. It will take some time.

speaker: ossian
line: Anvil's hot. I will watch the far ridges.

speaker: ossian
line: Rain of the Hunt is ready. Mark them, and they are mine.

speaker: ossian
line: Danger. There. It has seen us.

speaker: ossian
line: Something worth taking. There.

speaker: ossian
line: Another archer of a dead god. He would have laughed. He never laughed.

speaker: ossian
line: More hunters than quarry. Soon that will be true of the whole world.

speaker: mirren
line: Right, team. In, out, nobody dies. Well, everybody dies. But stylishly.

speaker: mirren
line: Bit of a snag, darlings. The snag is me. Bleeding.

speaker: mirren
line: Caught! How embarrassing. Spring me and I'll split the take.

speaker: mirren
line: Back on your feet, love. You owe me. I'm writing it down.

speaker: mirren
line: Two little trinkets become one big crime. Lovely.

speaker: mirren
line: Again! The dice love me. Eventually.

speaker: mirren
line: Solid gold, darling. I'd steal it, if it weren't already mine.

speaker: mirren
line: A new recipe! Let's call it a trade secret and charge admission.

speaker: mirren
line: Overdrive! Spend it like it's stolen!

speaker: mirren
line: They keep coming, and I keep collecting.

speaker: mirren
line: Every heist has a catch. I suppose I was it.

speaker: mirren
line: And that, darlings, is how you rob the end of the world.

speaker: mirren
line: Home again, pockets full. Don't tell Vessa.

speaker: mirren
line: Anvil's hot! Form a line. Mirren's discount applies.

speaker: mirren
line: Grand Heist is ready. Everybody, pockets open.

speaker: mirren
line: Trouble, there. Big, ugly, and not my type.

speaker: mirren
line: Loot! Mine. I mean, ours. Mostly mine.

speaker: mirren
line: Another me? Then who's watching the silverware?

speaker: mirren
line: More of me? Wonderful. Everybody keep one hand on your purse.

speaker: epoch
line: We have started. We have also finished. The middle is the interesting part.

speaker: epoch
line: My wounds are early. I'd scheduled them for later.

speaker: epoch
line: I remember this part. I didn't enjoy it next time either.

speaker: epoch
line: There. I've un-happened that for you.

speaker: epoch
line: Two parts, one future. The other futures are... disappointed.

speaker: epoch
line: Again. I prefer the version I haven't seen yet.

speaker: epoch
line: A new recipe. I've always known it. Now you do too.

speaker: epoch
line: Perfect timing. Mine, obviously.

speaker: epoch
line: Overdrive. Hurry. Patiently.

speaker: epoch
line: Tick. Tick. Tick. They fall on the beat.

speaker: epoch
line: Ah. This is where I stop. I always forget.

speaker: epoch
line: We won. I knew that yesterday. Tomorrow. Whenever.

speaker: epoch
line: Home. I was here a moment ago. And a year from now.

speaker: epoch
line: Anvil's hot. For thirty seconds. I've already counted them.

speaker: epoch
line: Stolen Second is ready. I'd give it back, but to whom?

speaker: epoch
line: Danger, there. In a moment. Now.

speaker: epoch
line: Loot. You pick it up in four seconds. Go on.

speaker: epoch
line: Another me. Early. You're always early.

speaker: epoch
line: More of me. Which one is the original? Neither. Both. Later.

speaker: smithshade
line: Sit by the forge and warm what's left of you. I've already started on the rest.

speaker: smithshade
line: Every time you come back, the anvil sings a little truer. Don't let it go to your head.

speaker: smithshade
line: I forged weapons for gods. Now I forge excuses for mortals. The work is steadier.

speaker: smithshade
line: Valdris fell in the Cinder Wastes again. I reforged him harder. He asked me to. That one worries me.

speaker: smithshade
line: Selene asked me to forge her a crown. I gave her a lightning rod. She hasn't noticed the difference.

speaker: smithshade
line: Kael never says thank you. He leaves spent casings on my anvil instead. I keep every one.

speaker: smithshade
line: Thessaly took my bellows apart to see how they breathe. They breathe better now. I resent that.

speaker: smithshade
line: Brax punched the anvil to say good morning. The anvil survived. So did Brax. Barely.

speaker: smithshade
line: Ossian prays over everything he kills. At this rate, the dead gods owe him a very long reply.

speaker: smithshade
line: Mirren swears she's never stolen from this forge. My second-best hammer swears otherwise.

speaker: smithshade
line: Epoch thanked me for a blade I haven't made yet. I suppose I'd better make it.

speaker: smithshade
line: Down you went, and up you'll come. The Forge doesn't accept resignations.

speaker: smithshade
line: I reforged you harder. Try to break a little less easily. Or at least more heroically.

speaker: smithshade
line: Death is only the Forge asking for another draft.

speaker: smithshade
line: Ash on my floor again. At least you're consistent.

speaker: smithshade
line: A godcore, brought home. Hear that hum? That's the Forge remembering what it was for.

speaker: smithshade
line: Not bad, for mortals. Not bad for gods, either. Don't tell them. They're dead, but they'd sulk.

speaker: smithshade
line: I'd embrace you, but I'm smoke and you're still on fire. Take the sentiment.

speaker: smithshade
line: A new recipe. Not even the gods tried that one. They weren't brave enough. Or foolish enough.

speaker: smithshade
line: Write it in the Codex, quick, before it writes itself on the walls.

speaker: smithshade
line: Go on, then. Hammer the world back into shape.

speaker: smithshade
line: Come back whole, or come back in pieces. Just come back.

speaker: smithshade
line: Gold. True gold. I felt that strike from here.

speaker: smithshade
line: Another tyrant cold on the stone. I remember when they were only ore.

speaker: vessa
line: Welcome back. Sign here, here, and here, where it says 'still technically alive'.

speaker: vessa
line: Ember logged. Shards counted. Your dignity arrived separately, as usual.

speaker: vessa
line: You left with a full kit and returned with most of a body. I've noted the discrepancy.

speaker: vessa
line: Valdris returns his kit polished. After dying. I don't trust anyone that tidy.

speaker: vessa
line: Selene requisitioned a mirror. 'For the field.' I've filed it under weapons, since she insists.

speaker: vessa
line: Kael signs his requisitions with a single bullet hole. I've learned to read them.

speaker: vessa
line: Thessaly's requisitions come with diagrams. The diagrams have footnotes. I look forward to them. Don't tell her.

speaker: vessa
line: Brax broke four gauntlets, two doors and one of my ledgers. He apologized to the ledger.

speaker: vessa
line: Ossian returns every arrow he didn't use. There are never any. He returns the quiver anyway. Solemnly.

speaker: vessa
line: Someone's been in the stores. Everything is dusted and alphabetized. Mirren is taunting me.

speaker: vessa
line: Epoch requisitioned something for next Tuesday. I approved it. Apparently I already had.

speaker: vessa
line: Forty percent of your shards made it back. More than can be said for you.

speaker: vessa
line: Death logged. Cause: optimism.

speaker: vessa
line: I salvaged what I could. Shards, mostly. Your Echo kept the weapon. It asked after you.

speaker: vessa
line: Another funeral I don't have to cater. The Forge is efficient that way.

speaker: vessa
line: Full extraction. Godcore intact. You, intact. I'll need a second form for that.

speaker: vessa
line: Victory. I'll mark it in red ink. The only red I'm ever glad to see.

speaker: vessa
line: Congratulations. Your reward is doing it again, but harder. I don't make the rules. I just count them.

speaker: vessa
line: New recipe logged. I've given it a shelf. The shelf looks nervous.

speaker: vessa
line: Another recipe. The Codex is getting heavy. Good. Heavy things are harder to steal.

speaker: vessa
line: Supplies issued. Please return them in fewer flames than last time.

speaker: vessa
line: Off you go. Try to die somewhere with decent salvage.

speaker: hound9
line: Hound-9 detects: returning Godforged. Wag protocol engaged.

speaker: hound9
line: Welcome home. Hound-9 kept your spot warm. Hound-9 was sitting in it.

speaker: hound9
line: Brax threw the ball into the lava again. Hound-9 retrieved it. Hound-9 would like to discuss boundaries. And do it again.

speaker: hound9
line: Valdris lets Hound-9 sleep against his armor. Thermal efficiency: excellent. Friendship efficiency: also excellent.

speaker: hound9
line: Kael does not pat Hound-9. Kael nods at Hound-9. Hound-9 has decided this counts.

speaker: hound9
line: Thessaly upgraded Hound-9's hearing. Hound-9 can now hear Vessa sigh from three rooms away.

speaker: hound9
line: Epoch said 'good dog' before Hound-9 did anything. Hound-9 is attempting to deserve it retroactively.

speaker: hound9
line: Godforged status: deceased. Hound-9 status: sad. Reforging: underway. Hound-9 status: less sad.

speaker: hound9
line: Hound-9 fetched what was left of you. Hound-9 is sorry. Hound-9 is also a very good fetcher.

speaker: hound9
line: Victory! Hound-9 is running in circles. This serves no purpose. Hound-9 does not care.

speaker: hound9
line: Godcore retrieved. Hound-9 requested to sniff it. Request denied by Vessa. Hound-9 sniffed it anyway.

speaker: hound9
line: New recipe archived. Hound-9 has buried a backup copy in the ash-yard. For safety.

speaker: hound9
line: Recipe detected. Hound-9's tail servo moved without authorization. Diagnosis: excitement.

speaker: hound9
line: Anvil temperature optimal! Hound-9 recommends: forging. Hound-9 also recommends: defending Hound-9.
